# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS - Current state

### Style

The repository uses a Laravel MVC architecture extended with server-driven Livewire components, Eloquent models, application Actions, Brain Actions, queued jobs, and provider-based infrastructure wiring (`app/`, `routes/`, `bootstrap/app.php`).

### Directory layout

```text
app/
|-- Actions/             # Focused application operations
|-- Brain/               # Validated Brain Actions and workflows
|-- Http/                # Controllers, middleware, requests, resources
|-- Livewire/            # Stateful UI components
|-- Models/              # Eloquent entities and relationships
|-- Services/            # External service clients and adapters
|-- Jobs/                # Queue jobs
|-- Support/             # Alerts, navigation, and helpers
config/                  # Laravel and integration configuration
database/
|-- migrations/          # Relational schema history
|-- factories/           # Test model builders
|-- seeders/             # Reference/bootstrap data
resources/               # Blade, CSS, and JavaScript assets
routes/                  # Web, auth, admin, search, channel, console routes
tests/                   # Brain, Browser, Feature, and Unit suites
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
|---|---|---|
| Routes/middleware | URL graph, authentication, coarse access gates | Business mutations |
| Controllers/Livewire | Request/UI state, validation entry, authorization, responses | External transport internals |
| Actions/Brain Actions | Application operations and validated workflows | HTTP presentation |
| Models | Persistence mapping, casts, relationships, query scopes | Route policy |
| Services/Support | External clients, alert pipeline, reusable adapters | UI rendering |
| Jobs/Horizon | Deferred execution, retry and queue selection | Interactive response state |

### External integration points

| System | Client config | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Discord | `config/alerts.php`, Laravel HTTP client | Receives throttled critical-error embeds |
| ViaCEP | `app/Services/ViaCep/ViaCepService.php` | Resolves Brazilian postal addresses |
| CNPJ provider | `app/Services/Cnpj/CnpjService.php` | Resolves company and partner data |
| Brevo | `app/Mail/BrevoTransport.php`, `config/mail.php` | Custom mail transport |
| Amazon S3 | `config/filesystems.php` | Media storage and temporary URLs |
| Redis/Horizon | `config/queue.php`, `config/horizon.php` | Queue execution, cache, and monitoring |

### Macro flow: critical error alert

```text
Throwable -> bootstrap exception reporter -> DiscordAlert::report
          -> UpsertSystemErrorAlert -> fingerprint throttle cache
          -> high_priority queue -> SendDiscordCriticalAlertJob
          -> Discord webhook
```

### Macro flow: Artisan command execution

```text
Admin Livewire UI -> CommandExecution row (Queued)
                  -> ExecuteArtisanCommandAction [long_timeout]
                  -> validate command/allowlist -> child PHP process
                  -> CommandExecution (Success or Error + output)
```
